engineering_verdict: TL072IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and TL082IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) qualify as Level 1 Candidate Drop-In peers: all 8 pins share identical electrical roles, exposed-pad nets match (no EP), and thermal/voltage/temperature-grade margins remain aligned. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 5.25 MHz (p.15) vs 5.25 MHz (p.14), supply ceiling 40 V (p.11) vs 40 V (p.9), Vos 6 mV (p.15) vs 6 mV (p.14), Ib 1x gap (65 vs 65 pA), voltage noise 37 vs 37 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TL072IDR "Negative-Rail Input Headroom Limit and Legacy Phase Reversal Trap" (p.11) and TL082IDR "Mixed Legacy SFAB vs Modern RFB Silicon Lottery Under Non-H TL082IDR (Table 9-1, p.28)" (p.28). BOM decision: Choose TL072IDR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOIC-8 (D) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose TL082IDR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOIC-8 (D) qualification and -40..85 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.5 vs TOP_VIEW p.5) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
